entities.summary: Abu al-Fath Ismail bin Nur al-Din Mahmud bin Imad al-Din bin Aq Sunqur al-Zangi  commonly known as As-Salih Ismaʿil al-Malik (Full name: was the Zengid emir of Damascus and emir of Aleppo in 1174, the son of Nur ad-Din.
